info.title: submission
info.description: This API collection enables Underwriters to retrieve information about Submission requests that have been supplied by a Broker as well as manage their negotiation of terms of cover.

tags.name: negotiation
tags.description: Enables the creation and management of the flow of negotiations from an Underwriter to a Broker. Negotiations shown will be those which (1) have been formally communicated to the Broker; and (2) 'saved' Negotiation records (i.e. that are waiting to be sent to the Broker).

tags.name: submission
tags.description: Enables the retrieval of Submissions for Underwriters.

put.description: Reassigns a Negotiation record to another Underwriter User. The destined Underwriter User does not have to be a member of the same Carrier Team owning the original Submission, but must exist within the same Company hierarchical structure. For the destined Underwriter User, either the entire Submission record is reassigned, or a new Submission record will be created (where there are multiple requests which remain with the original Underwriter User) for underwriting purposes.

This record includes structured data pertaining to a single Contract offering (and any subsequent Sections, if applicable) as well as references to download (1) the Market Reform Contract (MRC) document; and (2) any associated Supporting Documents.
